source.title: Ifa divination system — Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity, element 00146
source.author: UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage
source.notes: Inscribed 2008 on the Representative List (decision 3.COM 1), originally proclaimed 2005; nominated by Nigeria. Verified against the UNESCO page 2026-07-28. Cited for the institutional record of the tradition, not for verse content. Its statement that the corpus has 256 parts with roughly 800 ese per odu is the clearest citable figure for corpus scale.
